description: Append a dated typed progress entry through the durable Authority transaction without replacing existing progress history.

content.description: Progress entry body. A single leading H1/H2 title is ignored because MemAuthority owns the entry heading; H3/H4 subheadings are allowed, but H1/H2 headings inside the body are rejected.

name: memory_append_progress

description: Archive one MemAuthority project in current-HEAD lifecycle metadata while preserving its Authority history.
name: memory_archive_project

description: Create a new active MemAuthority project with a program-owned canonical handoff scaffold; no Vault template file is required.

aliases.description: Optional unique routing aliases for the project.

client_idempotency_key.description: Optional stable caller key for safe replay of the same mutation payload.

create_rules_role.description: If true, also create an empty canonical rules role; handoff is always created.

description.description: Short project description stored in INDEX.yaml.

evidence.description: Optional structured evidence metadata for the mutation; do not place secrets in durable content.

expected_index_revision.description: Current SHA-256 INDEX revision used for compare-and-swap.

lifecycle.description: Must be active for a newly created project.

local_path.description: Optional user-facing local path metadata; MemAuthority does not read arbitrary host files from this value.

name: memory_create_project

description: Record protected local or runtime verification state through the controlled mutation path after the required evidence has actually been checked.

verification_level.description: Verification kind: local verifies source code, configuration, documentation, static results, or other locally inspectable artifacts; runtime verifies the actual running environment, deployment state, or a real business flow.

name: memory_mark_verified

description: Perform the one-time legacy MemAuthority lifecycle migration through the transaction kernel; this is a migration operation, not normal project editing.
name: memory_migrate_lifecycle

description: Use this to read stored declarative runtime location, environment, repository, supervisor, check, and boundary metadata for a project. It does not execute checks, inspect the MemAuthority service itself, or prove current live deployment health.
name: memory_project_runtime

description: Use this to read a known handoff, rules, progress, or pitfalls memory resource by URI, optionally by heading or line range. Prefer it directly when the resource URI is already known; it does not read runtime resources. Eligible handoff reads also return checklist_items for top-level todos under 已知问题 / 待办.
name: memory_read

description: Idempotently append a typed reusable pitfall entry to project memory without replacing existing pitfalls.
name: memory_record_pitfall

description: Idempotently record a typed runtime conflict or completed fallback as control evidence without mutating project Authority.
name: memory_record_runtime_observation

description: Restore one archived MemAuthority project to active lifecycle state through the controlled mutation path.
name: memory_restore_project

description: Use this when the target MemAuthority project id is uncertain and you have a project name, alias, or repository identity. It resolves exact NFC-normalized, Unicode-casefolded registered project ids or aliases; do not use it when the project id or resource URI is already known.

query.description: Project routing query. Matching is exact after Unicode NFC normalization and case folding against project IDs and aliases; ambiguous and archived matches are reported explicitly.

name: memory_route

description: Use this to locate relevant indexed sections inside a known project when the exact memory resource or section is unknown. It returns up to 50 coordinate-like hits for selective reading, not final proof or complete context; truncated=true means additional matches exist. It does not resolve uncertain project identity.

cross_project.description: Set true to search all registered projects; otherwise project_id is required.

project_id.description: Project id to search when cross_project is false.

query.description: Text to search for in indexed memory sections; must be non-empty.

name: memory_search

description: Use this to inspect the MemAuthority service and Authority workspace itself: Git head, owned snapshot, projection, write gate, fencing, journal, and recovery state. It does not report a project's deployment location or live production service health.
name: memory_status

description: Use this for direct replacement of allowed canonical handoff sections with resource CAS. Prefer memory_update_sections when you need ordered append/insert/delete operations, checklist item changes, or edits outside the handoff role.
name: memory_update_handoff

description: Use this only when optional runtime metadata is enabled and deployment/work-environment topology is worth retaining. A single environment may omit environment_id (canonicalized to default), host_id is optional and user-defined, and environment kinds archive/deployment/service/workspace, supervisors docker/docker_compose/none/process/systemd_system/systemd_user, and checks directory_exists/docker_compose_services/failed_units/file_exists/git_head/git_status/systemd_units remain validated vocabularies. It uses runtime and INDEX revision/CAS safeguards and does not execute deployments or live health checks.

client_idempotency_key.description: Optional caller idempotency key. Reusing the same key with the same payload replays the committed result; reusing it for a different payload conflicts.

expected_index_revision.description: Required INDEX CAS revision in sha256:<64 hex> form. Stale values return conflict after static runtime validation passes.

expected_resource_revision.description: Runtime resource CAS revision in sha256:<64 hex> form when replacing an existing runtime. Omit only when creating the project's first registered runtime.

project_id.description: Registered active MemAuthority project id. runtime.project_id must match this value.

environments.description: One to 64 declarative runtime environments. This metadata describes stored topology and does not execute or prove live checks.

boundaries.description: Mutation/deployment boundary flags. production_writer and mutation_requires_explicit_authorization are required booleans; single_writer is optional.

capabilities.description: Zero to 16 unique capabilities. Supported values: build, deploy_source, deploy_target, edit, read_only, runtime_check, test.

checks.description: Zero to 32 declarative check specifications. Checks are stored only; memory_update_runtime does not execute them.

compose_file.description: Required absolute compose file path for docker_compose_services.

kind.description: Check discriminator. Supported values: directory_exists, docker_compose_services, failed_units, file_exists, git_head, git_status, systemd_units. Companion fields depend on kind.

path.description: Required absolute path for file_exists and directory_exists.

scope.description: Required for systemd_units and failed_units; supported values: user, system.

services.description: Required non-empty service list for docker_compose_services.

target.description: Optional for git_status and git_head; omitted values default to repository. If provided for those checks, the only supported value is repository.

units.description: Required non-empty unit list for systemd_units.

description.description: Short non-empty single-line description, at most 500 characters.

environment_id.description: Optional for a single environment; omission is canonicalized to default. Multi-environment manifests must provide a unique stable id matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$.

host_id.description: Optional user-defined execution host identity matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$. Use it only when grouping multiple environments by machine or logical host is useful.

kind.description: Environment shape. Supported values: archive, deployment, service, workspace.

purpose.description: Environment purpose. Supported values: backup, disabled_mirror, production, production_reader, source_development, staging, test.

repository.description: Optional repository metadata. When present, path and branch are required; path must be absolute and remote is optional.

supervisor.description: Supervisor declaration. Required companion fields depend on supervisor.kind; only fields for that kind are accepted.

compose_file.description: Required absolute compose file path only for docker_compose supervisors.

containers.description: Required non-empty container list only for docker supervisors.

kind.description: Supervisor discriminator. Supported values: docker, docker_compose, none, process, systemd_system, systemd_user. none requires no companion fields; systemd_user/systemd_system require units; docker_compose requires compose_file and services; docker requires containers; process requires process_name and pid_file.

pid_file.description: Required absolute pid file path only for process supervisors.

process_name.description: Required non-empty process name only for process supervisors.

services.description: Required non-empty service list only for docker_compose supervisors.

units.description: Required non-empty unit list only for systemd_user or systemd_system supervisors.

workdir.description: Absolute environment working directory without . or .. traversal segments.

project_id.description: Project id stored in the runtime manifest; must equal the top-level project_id target.

relations.description: Zero to 128 directed relations between declared environment_id values.

from.description: Source environment_id; must reference a declared environment and differ from to.

kind.description: Relation kind. Supported values: deploys_to, mirrors.

to.description: Destination environment_id; must reference a declared environment and differ from from.

schema_version.description: Runtime schema version. The only supported value is 1.

verification.description: Either empty/unverified, or complete with verified_at, verified_by, stale_after, and one or more memory:// Authority evidence URIs.

evidence.description: Authority evidence references only. Each value must be a memory:// URI; write observed facts to handoff/progress first, then reference that resource here.

stale_after.description: Positive day duration in PnD form, for example P30D.

verified_at.description: RFC3339 verification timestamp. If verification is populated, all verification fields are required.

verified_by.description: Non-empty verifier identity. If verification is populated, all verification fields are required.

name: memory_update_runtime

description: Use this for ordered typed section edits across supported memory roles with resource CAS. H2 operations may replace, append, insert, or delete according to role; handoff also supports checklist_remove and checklist_set_checked using item_ref values returned by memory_read. Prefer memory_update_handoff for simple whole-section handoff replacement.

expected_resource_revision.description: SHA-256 revision returned by memory_read; mutation fails on mismatch.

operations.description: Ordered typed section operations. Supported operations depend on role and may replace, append, insert, or delete H2 sections; handoff additionally supports checklist_remove and checklist_set_checked. Checklist operations cannot be mixed with H2 operations in one batch.

checked.description: Target checked state; required only for checklist_set_checked.

content.description: Section body for replace, append, or insert. Do not provide for checklist operations.

heading.description: Target H2 heading. Checklist operations are restricted to 已知问题 / 待办.

item_ref.description: Opaque checklist item_ref returned by memory_read; required only for checklist_remove and checklist_set_checked.

operation.description: Section operation. Supported H2 operations depend on role; handoff also supports checklist_remove and checklist_set_checked for top-level todo items.

role.description: One of handoff, rules, progress, or pitfalls.

name: memory_update_sections
